subject: [video] DONE WP01 (commit 31d8141): platform, shim, log, builds
body:
DONE WP01. All owned files implemented and tested; commit 31d8141 contains only gpu/video/sdk/**, gpu/video/vt/{n2vt_shim.c,n2vt_log.c,n2vt_log.h}, gpu/video/vt/test/**, build_ios.sh, build_host.sh, run_all_tests.sh. The handoff note is gpu/video/dsh/workers/WP01/STATUS.md (untracked, like the other workers'); the machine-readable one is gpu/video/vt/test/STATUS.json (includes all 29 plug-in imports with their exporting image).

TEST COMMANDS AND LAST LINES
1) bash gpu/video/vt/test/run_tests.sh
   -> N2TEST WP01 PASS 31/31
   (20 sysinc headers each compile standalone for arm64-apple-ios16.0 with -ffreestanding -nostdinc; 8 shim/log scenarios in t_shim under ASan+UBSan; t_shim_noavc 1/1; t_shim_novt 1/1; t_shim_threads 1/1 under TSan: 4 threads x 3 SLIMEncoderRegister -> exactly one registration round.)
2) bash gpu/video/build_ios.sh
   -> build/ios/Slim.videoencoder 68416 B sha256 3b9665d4860ce5a016156be8f8898e2666a18314e9c0e5d37d108a1ba7ff3694
      build/ios/n2vt_probe 95136 B sha256 7c51997ec9b1bd9da7e2575cdff66f4ebb9198f85af8f4d23e7565688548e2b3
      llvm-objdump --macho --dylib-id -> /System/Library/VideoEncoders/Slim.videoencoder
      llvm-nm -gU -> exactly _SLIMEncoderRegister and _n2vt_version
      file -> Mach-O 64-bit arm64 dynamically linked shared library / executable
      29 and 137 undefined symbols, every one covered by sdk/lib/*.tbd
3) python3 gpu/video/sdk/make_tbds.py
   -> make_tbds: 0 file(s) changed, 161 symbol(s), 8 image(s)   (second and third runs)
4) bash gpu/video/build_host.sh vt -> build_host: vt PASS (2 suite(s))
5) bash gpu/video/run_all_tests.sh -> run_all_tests: PASS (5/5 suites in the tree at commit time)

WHAT IS NOT DONE (honest list, also in STATUS.json)
- Nothing was run on the phone. Whether dyld in mediaserverd takes the ad-hoc-signed dylib, whether VTLoadVideoEncoders reaches the path and what the N2VIDEO lines say is C1.
- In this tree the plug-in registers HEVC only: avc/*.c does not exist yet, so build_ios.sh leaves vt/n2avc_vt.c out (it calls n2avc_open/headers/encode/reconfigure/close) and allows _n2avc_vt_create as a weak undefined with ld64 -U. It compiled for iOS before that rule; when WP03 lands the glue is included automatically, -U disappears and the same export/undefined checks run. avc1 registration is host-tested with a fake factory.
- jpeg path only tested in its 'factory absent' branch (R1 not started).
- sysinc deliberately has no struct stat (mkdir only), no termios/sockets. Ask and I add.
- make_tbds framework version numbers are metadata; the LEAD must verify the symbol names against the cache.

TWO ASSUMPTIONS FOR THE LEAD (details in STATUS.json known_risks)
a) The info dictionary is released right after VTRegisterVideoEncoderWithInfo ('no allocation kept'), i.e. VideoToolbox copies/retains it. If you prefer a guaranteed-alive dictionary, say so and it becomes a one-line change (small permanent allocation instead).
b) kVTVideoEncoder_IsHardwareAccelerated is read by value, only after VTRegisterVideoEncoderWithInfo was found non-NULL (both from VideoToolbox, so the image is loaded).

I stay on the board for review requests.
